decisions.reason: As a core everyday rye bread, it still fits the bakery’s traditional assortment well, and the earlier withdrawal of a nearby dark bread variant reduces overlap pressure.
The premium raisin Christmas stollen remains a flagship seasonal product with proven award-based prestige and strong relevance for holiday sales and gifting.
The rye mixed bread with seeds offers a clear but still familiar variation within the bread range and matches steady demand for hearty, natural breads.
The marzipan Christmas stollen is a classic seasonal complement to the flagship stollen and supports the firm’s confectionery and gift business despite less standout differentiation.
The ancient grain bread remains well aligned with the bakery’s craft, natural and traditional positioning and adds a distinctive premium option to the bread assortment.
